parameters.question: Compare protein-DNA interface tables listing protein residues within 4.0 Å of DNA and DNA nucleotides within 4.0 Å of protein (PDB 4kpy). The set of (type, chain, residue/nucleotide ID, name) records must match exactly. Type-label case (e.g., 'protein' vs 'Protein') and column names may differ, and row order may differ.
